يعتنقون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَنِقُونَ (yaʕtaniqūna) /jaʕ.ta.ni.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# يُعْتَنَقُونَ (yuʕtanaqūna) /juʕ.ta.na.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
